# Psalm 39 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster, for-Jeduthun. A-psalm of-David.

**2** I-said, 'I-will-guard my-ways from-sinning with-my-tongue; I-will-guard my-mouth [with] a-muzzle while the-wicked [is] before-me.'

**3** I-was-mute [with] silence; I-was-silent from-good, and-my-pain was-stirred.

**4** My-heart grew-hot within-me; in-my-musing a-fire burned. [Then] I-spoke with-my-tongue:

**5** 'Make-me-know, YHWH, my-end, and-the-measure of-my-days — what it [is]. Let-me-know how-fleeting I [am].

**6** Behold, handbreadths You-have-made my-days, and-my-lifetime [is] as-nothing before-You. Surely all-vanity [is] every-man standing. Selah.

**7** Surely in-a-shadow a-man walks-about; surely in-vain they-bustle. He-heaps-up and-does-not-know who gathers [them].

**8** And-now, what do-I-wait-for, Lord? My-hope — it [is] in-You.

**9** From-all my-transgressions deliver-me; the-reproach of-the-fool do-not make-me.

**10** I-am-mute; I-do-not open my-mouth, for You have-done [it].

**11** Remove from-me Your-stroke; from-the-hostility of-Your-hand I-am-consumed.

**12** With-rebukes for-iniquity You-discipline a-man, and-You-consume like-a-moth his-treasure. Surely [mere] vanity [is] every-man. Selah.

**13** Hear my-prayer, YHWH, and-my-cry-for-help give-ear-to; to-my-tears do-not be-silent. For a-stranger [am] I with-You, a-sojourner like-all my-fathers.'

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **39:6**: Hevel — 'breath/vapor/vanity.' The same word that dominates Ecclesiastes. Human existence is as insubstantial as exhaled air.

— EMET
